title: Goal 2. Project Design Registry and production-faithful preview
summary: Replace fixed design and composition tables with one deterministic provider registry and add isolated preview over the same production services.
done_when: One deterministic DesignRegistry owns built-in, package and project layouts, views, sections and blocks.
Composition compatibility is artifact-driven without central layout, region, section, block or Smart ID lists.
Preview reuses production registries, Gateway, renderer, composer and PageBuilder with isolated output.
Public full/single parity, determinism, static, security and browser evidence pass.
